docs: docs/13 amendment A7 (R1 pretext tournament, family H17); docs/12 F23 to F25; docs/11 sections 1 to 11
status: SMOKE of experiments/ssl_r1_pretext.py (build check only; no number from it is reported as a result). Arm A1 at C = 4,096 on a 300k-token prefix, 1 epoch, AG News only at 32 labels per class, one draw. Train splits only; no test split, never SST-2 validation.
fixed_before_any_r1_output: every parameter below, the arm definitions of src/tmlm/ssl/pretext.py, the carve of src/tmlm/ssl/downstream.py, the draws and probes of src/tmlm/ssl/probes.py and the controls of src/tmlm/ssl/controls.py were written before any R1 output existed (2026-09-24, after the A7 freeze of 20:08 UTC)

readings_of_a7_open_points.f1_frequency: f(y) = relative frequency of y in the 20M-token training prefix
readings_of_a7_open_points.f1_draw: keep iff (mix64(p) >> 32) < q32(prob), prob >= 1 keeps always; no seed, no epoch: one subsample for all seeds and epochs
readings_of_a7_open_points.f2_selection: per epoch e, per class with more than M positions, the M positions with the smallest rng64(0, 0xA7F2, e, p, 0); redrawn per epoch; one engine instance per epoch loading the previous state
readings_of_a7_open_points.random_kind_map: one fixed permutation of the token ids (ascending rng64(0, 0xA7C6, t, 0, 0)) applied to kind_map levels 1 to 3; sym_freq recomputed from the same token counts
readings_of_a7_open_points.c0y: checkpoint after ceil(0.01 x batches of epoch 1) batches of the same run
readings_of_a7_open_points.dim_matched: the 8,192 clauses with the most firing positions over the 20M-token prefix, nothing hidden except the position itself (ties to the lower id)
readings_of_a7_open_points.gplus: exact counts over every prefix position; positive exact literals of the arm's mode offsets and kinds 0..3 plus SYM_EDGE; pairs at different offsets only; top C by count (single before pair, then literal ids); dimension-matched G+ = its first 8,192
readings_of_a7_open_points.dev_carve: mix64(example index) mod 20 in {1, 2} of each train split (10 percent)
readings_of_a7_open_points.label_draws: 5 draws, nested budgets, per class min(n, class pool size), numpy SeedSequence([20260924, 717, task code, draw, class])
readings_of_a7_open_points.tm_probe: tmu TMCoalescedClassifier on binary features: dimension-matched columns of the banks and G+, all columns of bag of words and cluster bag of words, 8 thermometer bits per PPMI-SVD dimension; grid by 4-fold CV in the labelled sample; run at 32 labels per class only (H17.11)
readings_of_a7_open_points.full_budget: supported by --full; not in the default launch (cost); to be run for the top arms
readings_of_a7_open_points.winner_variant: the report ranks both 'all clauses' and 'dimension-matched'; A7 does not say which variant decides the winner: this is decided before the report is read

arms.A3: F2 (at most M = 2,000 targets per class per epoch, redrawn per epoch), masked
arms.A6: A1 with a random kind_map (one fixed token permutation applied to the three cluster levels)
